definition_quote.value: 'Practice dietetics' means to apply the principles derived from integrating knowledge of food, biochemistry, physiology, management science, behavioral science, and social science to human nutrition.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice dietetics" means to apply the principles derived from integrating knowledge of food, biochemistry, physiology, management science, behavioral science, and social science to human nutrition.

value: Assessing individual and community food practices and nutritional status using anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, dietary, and demographic data
Developing, establishing, and evaluating nutritional care plans
Nutrition counseling and education as a part of preventive or restorative health care
Determining, applying, and evaluating standards for food and nutrition services
Applying scientific research to the role of food in the maintenance of health and the treatment of disease
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice dietetics" includes: (i) Assessing individual and community food practices and nutritional status using anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, dietary, and demographic data, for clinical, research, and program planning purposes; (ii) Developing, establishing, and evaluating nutritional care plans that establish priorities, goals, and objectives for meeting nutrient needs for individuals or groups; (iii) Nutrition counseling and education as a part of preventive or restorative health care throughout the life cycle; (iv) Determining, applying, and evaluating standards for food and nutrition services; and (v) Applying scientific research to the role of food in the maintenance of health and the treatment of disease.

value: licensed dietitian-nutritionist
license_type_structure.quote: "Dietitian-nutritionist" means, unless the context requires otherwise, an individual who is licensed by the Board to practice dietetics.

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: "Medical nutrition" means the nutritional advice or counsel provided to an individual by a licensee in their professional capacity that is designed for an individual to alleviate a specific physiological complaint, condition, or symptom.

direct_supervision_defined.quote: "Supervision" means the management of an individual who aids in the practice of dietetics by a licensed dietitian-nutritionist who may or may not be on the premises.
